name: BSP_MenuInterface_ServicePendingRequests
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_on_move_map, read-only analysis. __fastcall(bool *out). For each of DAT_00e198ac and DAT_00e198b4, when the object's +0x3C flag is set it compares two index pairs ([1] vs [8] and [7] vs [0xE]), calls vtable+0x10 with the two target indices to service the difference, and writes 1 through the out pointer. Sole caller BSP_Game_OnMove at 004e5442 and again at 004e5477 inside the drain loop the decompiler removed as unreachable (004e5455-004e5488). | Packet game_session_polls: the four globals are 00e198ac, 00e198b4, 00e198b8 and 00e198c4, in that order, and the duplicated compare in the pseudocode collapses to one predicate: obj != 0 && *(char*)(obj+3Ch) != 0 && (*(int*)(obj+04h) != *(int*)(obj+20h) || *(int*)(obj+1Ch) != *(int*)(obj+38h)), then virtual +10h with the two targets and *out = 1. The out byte therefore means work was done, not that a channel is active. Both call sites are in BSP_Game_OnMove: 004e5442 and 004e5477, the latter inside the do/while at 004e5455-004e5488 that Ghidra removed as unreachable. That loop is the whole termination rule: it repeats 00776230 and 004c40f0 until one full pass over the four channels reports nothing pending, with no iteration bound. See docs/GAME_SESSION_POLLS.md.

name: BSP_LogoSequence_OnMovieComplete
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. NO GHIDRA FUNCTION EXISTS AT THIS ADDRESS: the body 00685060-0068506F was decoded from disk bytes with bsp.py disasm-raw and reads MOV ECX,[00E198A4]; TEST ECX,ECX; JE 0068506F; JMP 00685070. The integrator must define the function before applying this name. Static trampoline, no arguments, no stack cleanup. BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish installs it on the movie player at 006850ba through 004f8970([00E18D48], 00685060) before starting each entry, so when the current logo movie ends the callback re-enters the advance with the logo object in ECX and the next entry plays. This is the automatic advance docs/GAME_FRONTEND_STATES.md could not locate: the logo sequence is driven by movie completion, not by a timer, and the float at logo+78h is the minimum age before BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip accepts a manual skip. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md

name: BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the logo object at 00E198A4, RET 0. Two callers: BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip 006851c7 (tail jump) and BSP_LogoSequence_LoadTable 00685300. count = (this+48h - this+44h) / 8 over an 8-byte-element vector; index = this+60h. When index >= count it calls this->vtable[0] with 1 (a deleting form, the argument is pushed) and then BSP_Game_OnInitOnce(game, 0), which re-runs GGame::OnInitTitle and writes game+5D4h = 2. That is the state 1 to state 2 transition, a direct state write rather than a queued request. Otherwise it increments the index and registers the callback 00685060 on 00E18D48 through 004f8970 for the next logo. | Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis, body read from the listing 00685070-006851??. Resolves the open question in docs/GAME_FRONTEND_STATES.md. Order after the unsigned exhaustion test at 0068508d: +60h = index + 1; 006850ba installs the end-of-movie trampoline BSP_LogoSequence_OnMovieComplete (00685060) on the movie player through 004f8970([00E18D48], 00685060); 006850f4 starts the movie with 004f8a20([00E18D48], &entries[index], 1, 0.0f, 0); 00685101 sets the movie-screen bytes +4h and +5h, calls BSP_FrontEndScreen_CommitVisibility and its virtual +18h; 00685117 samples the clock [01090AB0] virtual +20h and copies all four dwords of the 16-byte timestamp to +68h; 0068515c writes +78h = ((float*)[+54h])[index]. Because the trampoline re-enters this routine when the movie ends, the sequence advances on movie completion; there is no timer. The exhausted arm runs virtual +0h with 1 then BSP_Game_OnInitOnce(game, 0). Reconstructed as bsp::logo_advance_or_finish in src/title_init.cpp. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md

name: BSP_LogoSequence_PollSkip
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet game_frontend_states, read-only analysis. __thiscall, ECX = the 0x80 logo object at 00E198A4, no stack arguments, RET 0. Sole caller GGame::OnMove 004e4bee under game state 1. Body: clock 01090AB0 virtual +20h fills a 16-byte timestamp from this+68h, BSP_Timestamp_Subtract 00530890 returns it, elapsed = fild[eax] / fild[eax+8]; if elapsed > this+78h (float) and the edge-triggered input query 004d92b0(game, 0x4A) is true, tail jump to 00685070. Both conditions are required, so this is only the skip poll; the automatic advance is not in this body. The logo table comes from Scripts/datatables/Logos.lua via 00685300 (fields delay, (platform), (region), Szplessek). | Packet game_title_init, read-only analysis. The two-term conjunction is confirmed from the listing: FCOMIP at 006851aa then JBE at 006851ae make the time term strictly greater (a NaN elapsed takes the JBE), and only then 004d92b0(game, 4Ah) is queried. The Uncertain paragraph this record supported is now answered: the automatic advance is the end-of-movie trampoline BSP_LogoSequence_OnMovieComplete (00685060) that BSP_LogoSequence_AdvanceOrFinish installs at 006850ba, so this routine is only the manual skip and +78h is the minimum age before a skip is accepted. Reconstructed as bsp::logo_poll_skip and bsp::logo_skip_allowed in src/title_init.cpp. docs/GAME_TITLE_INIT.md
